mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the powered tile was most worthwhile: the tether caught it, and releasing the switch let it settle, making the safety setup meaningful.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the switch to the battery was clear but less interesting on its own, with no explanation at that step.

surprise.text: The tile rose without a propeller or balloon, then rose more slowly with the test weight attached. The story clearly identifies its lift as invented science.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the goals named each operation, and leaving the post tops clear made sense when the cradle slid onto them.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the tested lift tile might be used in Jo’s flying fair, especially now that its tethered lift has worked.
